prompt: Improve an existing native desktop operations application used for long-running jobs. Preserve the platform and toolkit conventions while clarifying navigation, menus and commands, keyboard-first operation, precision-pointer behavior, progress, partial results, errors, cancellation, destructive confirmation, focus when windows activate/deactivate, resize, display scaling, and relaunch restoration. Produce an implementation and verification contract for the real native runtime without replacing the app with browser-shaped navigation.

requirements: existing windows, menus, commands, and components

falsifiableChecks.assertion: Window, menu, command, shortcut, focus, and navigation behavior follows the identified native platform/toolkit conventions or documents a concrete product reason for divergence; browser-shaped navigation is not substituted.
Running, loading, partial-result, error, cancellation, failed-cancellation, completion, and destructive-action states have explicit observable behavior and domain-versus-presentation ownership.
Representative workflows are operable by keyboard and precision pointer with deterministic focus behavior across window activation/deactivation, commands, dialogs, and recovery.
The contract defines behavior for supported window resizing and display/text scaling without clipping or hiding critical actions/state, and verification exercises representative size/scale changes.
Relaunch/interruption restoration distinguishes durable job/domain state from ephemeral presentation state and is verified in the real native runtime or a faithful native simulator.

evidence: window, menu, command, shortcut, and focus behavior
loading, partial, error, cancellation, and destructive states
real native runtime or faithful simulator evidence

requiredEvidence: input, focus, resize, and scaling checks
